title.zh: 欢迎来到KidsLab · 从一盏灯到宇宙
title.en: Welcome to KidsLab · From a Lamp to the Cosmos

description.zh: 一场 Three.js 宇宙拉远之旅：从书桌上的一盏灯，穿过城市与地球，抵达银河与宇宙深处。四行诗与轻史诗配乐随尺度生长，点击底部圆点可在六个尺度间穿梭。
description.en: A Three.js cosmic zoom-out: from a desk lamp, past the city and the Earth, to the galaxy and the deep universe. A four-line poem and a light-epic score grow with the scale — tap the dots to jump between six worlds.

description.zh: 切一块披萨，认识分数！调整分子分母，看看小数、百分数和等值分数怎么变。
description.en: Slice a pizza to meet fractions! Tweak the numerator and denominator to see decimals, percentages and equivalent fractions change.

description.zh: 夜晚森林里圈住数字萤火虫，让它们相加正好等于灯笼上的目标数。凑出 10 会触发最亮的光爆——凑十法是最划算的抓法！
description.en: Lasso glowing number fireflies so they add up to the lantern's target. Making ten sets off the brightest burst — the make-ten trick pays!

description.zh: 客人订 24 个苹果？拖出 4 行 × 6 列播种，浇水长成果林正好交货！同一订单多种种法，转个方向就是交换律——乘法是种出来的。
description.en: An order for 24 apples? Plant 4 rows × 6 columns, water them, and harvest exactly right! Many layouts per order — rotate the field and discover commutativity.

description.zh: 把帽子和上衣拖到小羊驼身上，咔嚓拍下每一套不重样的搭配挂上照片墙；最后反过来为 12 套时装秀设计两张不同的进货单。
description.en: Drag hats and tops onto a little alpaca, snap every unique outfit onto the photo wall, then work backward to design two different stock orders for a 12-look fashion show.

description.zh: 把 23×14 的大厦拆成四块彩色施工区，算对一块就看它满墙窗户逐格亮起；通关还有竖式 X 光揭秘每一行来自哪块楼。最后化身拆迁队，一层层炸掉 312 间房，亲手拆出除法。
description.en: Split a 23×14 tower into four colour-coded build zones and watch every window light up as you solve each block, then see a long-multiplication X-ray map each line to a zone. Finally join the demolition crew and blast 312 rooms floor by floor to uncover division.

description.zh: 用固定长度的栅栏给仓鼠围草地：同样的周长，围法不同面积天差地别！靠墙围、L 形围，当一名让仓鼠开心打滚的围栏设计师。
description.en: Fence a lawn for hamsters with a fixed length of fence: same perimeter, wildly different areas! Use walls and L-shapes to make every hamster roll with joy.

topic.zh: 长方形和正方形的周长

description.zh: 一场十倍缩放之旅：从 1 米的小朋友出发，滚一格放大 10 倍——树、城市、地球、银河；再反向钻进瓢虫、蚂蚁的眼睛。数位不是练习册上的表格，是宇宙的楼层。
description.en: A powers-of-ten journey: start at a 1-meter kid, scroll to zoom ×10 — trees, cities, Earth, the galaxy; then dive down into ladybugs and ants' eyes. Place value isn't a worksheet — it's the floors of the universe.

description.zh: 拖着蘸了颜料的车轮滚一圈，量出这条线有多长。换三种大小的轮子比一比，圆周率 π 会自己从你的记录表里冒出来。再把圆切成小片拼成长方形，就看懂了圆面积公式 πr²。
description.en: Roll a paint-dipped wheel one full turn and measure the line it paints. Compare three wheel sizes and π emerges from your own data table. Then slice a circle and rebuild it as a rectangle to see where area = πr² comes from.

description.zh: 皮影戏舞台后藏着 3D 积木：固定光源从幕布正前方投影，圆柱正着看是圆、侧着看是长方形！挑选并转动积木，观察不同立体图形的影子剪影。
description.en: Behind the shadow-play stage hide 3D blocks: a fixed front light projects each solid onto the curtain, so a cylinder can appear as a circle head-on or a rectangle from the side. Pick and rotate blocks to explore each silhouette.

description.zh: 机器人摄影师从正面、上面、侧面拍方块雕塑，你来预测照片；反过来只给三张照片，亲手一块块搭出看不见的雕塑——三视图是拼出来的空间想象。
description.en: A robot photographer shoots voxel sculptures from the front, top and side — you predict each photo. Then flip it: given just three photos, build the hidden sculpture block by block.

description.zh: 用单位小方块搭鱼缸、数方块算体积，给每条鱼配够水量；再把丑石头丢进满水缸，溢出的水正好流进量杯——不规则物体的体积被你量出来了！
description.en: Build tanks from unit cubes, count blocks to find volume, and give every fish enough water. Then drop a lumpy rock into a full tank — the overflow fills a measuring cup, and you've measured the unmeasurable!

topic.zh: 长方体和正方体的体积、容积

description.zh: 长方形纸片一转成圆柱、三角形一转成圆锥——旋转体亲眼看见！再用圆锥杯舀冰淇淋倒进等底等高的圆柱杯，大中小三种杯子各倒一遍：圆锥体积和圆柱的关系，是你自己数出来的。
description.en: Spin a rectangle into a cylinder and a triangle into a cone — solids of revolution before your eyes! Then scoop with a cone cup into a cylinder of equal base and height, once for each of three cup sizes: you count your way to how cone volume relates to cylinder volume.

description.zh: 拖动 a、b、c 三个旋钮，亲眼看见一次函数、二次函数、反比例和正弦曲线如何变形。
description.en: Drag the a, b, c knobs and watch linear, quadratic, inverse and sine curves morph in real time.

description.zh: 当小镇钟楼管理员，拨动联动的时针和分针，按时叫醒面包房、校车、钓鱼客和晚安灯，认识整时、半时与几时几分。
description.en: Run the town clock tower. Move its linked hands to wake the bakery, school bus, fishing crew, and bedtime lights while learning hours, half-hours, and minutes.

description.zh: 不用拖动瞄准线，直接报出角度击球：从 0° 直推、锐角穿门，一路打到三墙反弹的几何神仙球。
description.en: Call the angle instead of dragging an aim line: master a 0° putt, thread an acute-angle gate, then finish with a three-bank geometry trick shot.

description.zh: 开动四条数位流水线，把 10 颗珠子压成 1 个高位零件，也把 1 个高位零件拆成 10 个低位零件，亲手完成进位与退位。
description.en: Run four place-value lines: press 10 parts into 1 higher-place part or split 1 into 10 lower-place parts to master carrying and borrowing.

description.zh: 输入正方形面积，用蓝图看懂平方根、整数夹逼、根式化简与小数近似。
description.en: Enter a square's area and use a live blueprint to explore square roots, integer bounds, radical simplification, and decimal estimates.

description.zh: 在半张纸上甩墨、对折，亲手孵出轴对称怪物；再补全镜像，揪出混进图鉴的冒牌货。
description.en: Splash one half of the page, fold it into a line-symmetric monster, complete mirror points, and catch the impostor in the gallery.

description.zh: 把一小节切成二分之一、四分之一和八分之一节拍，用耳朵听懂等值分数，再拼出点亮全场的完整律动。
description.en: Slice one measure into halves, quarters, and eighths, hear equivalent fractions, and build a complete groove that lights the whole house.

description.zh: 走进动物电视台，用“正”字收集台歌投票，为不同问题挑选条形图、折线图和扇形图，再根据数据完成直播播报。
description.en: Join Animal TV: tally theme-song votes, match questions with bar, line, and pie charts, then deliver a live report from the data.

description.zh: 把煎饼两面排进双格铁板，用 9 分钟完成三张饼，再让豆浆机和煎饼同时开工。
description.en: Schedule both sides of each pancake on a two-slot griddle, finish three pancakes in 9 minutes, and run the soy maker in parallel.

description.zh: 让跷跷板两边永远做同一件事，解开三场重量谜题；偷偷只动一边，演员会滚成一团。
description.en: Keep both sides of the seesaw doing the same thing to solve three weight mysteries—touch only one side and the whole troupe tumbles.

description.zh: 敲开合数水晶，把 12 和 18 一路分解成质数原石，再用 3 号音叉点亮整面倍数矿墙。
description.en: Crack composite crystals until 12 and 18 become prime stones, then light a wall of multiples with the No. 3 tuning fork.

description.zh: 选择豌豆、向日葵或番茄，调节光照、湿度、温度和养分，浇水施肥并快进时间，观察植物从种子到开花结果的变化。
description.en: Choose a pea, sunflower, or tomato plant, tune light, humidity, temperature, and nutrients, then water, fertilize, and fast-forward time to watch realistic growth.

description.zh: 在 3D 摆架上抓起摆球放手，调摆长、质量、摆角、阻力与时间流速，去四个星球对比仿真周期与 T≈2π√(L/g)。
description.en: Grab the bob on a 3D rig, tune length, mass, angle, drag and time speed, and compare the simulated period with T≈2π√(L/g) on four planets.

description.zh: 守住 3:2 的月光配方，从 15 勺小锅放大到 500 勺星光池，再按 2:3:5 为三只猫分好 100 枚金币。
description.en: Keep a 3:2 moonlight recipe true from a 15-spoon pot to a 500-spoon starlight pool, then share 100 coins among three cats in a 2:3:5 ratio.

description.en: Pilot a lift-craft across sea level, then use the same number line to compare below-zero temperatures and balance positive and negative transactions.

description.en: Investigate three suspicious sales, calculate the real checkout prices with percentages, and match every verdict with mathematical evidence.

description.zh: 在夜航坐标城报数对、抵消风偏，再用比例尺算出跨城航程，完成三封紧急投递。
description.en: Call coordinates across a night city, correct for wind drift, and use map scales to finish three urgent deliveries.

description.en: Audit carnival booths with a thousand-trial machine, expose inflated prize claims through stable frequencies, then design your own low-odds wheel.

description.zh: 在 3D 天平和量筒上称重、排水，用现场读数画出质量—体积线，看斜率锁定材料。
description.en: Weigh and dunk three mystery metals on a 3D balance and cylinder. Live readings draw the mass–volume line and lock the material.

description.zh: 元宵节布置灯笼街：先报数领货再挂灯，发现两端、一端、环形其实是同一道间隔题，锯木头和爬楼梯也会露馅。
description.en: Hang lanterns for the festival: order first, place next, and discover that both ends, open ends, rings, saw cuts, and stairs are the same interval problem.

description.zh: 在 3D 轨道上给小车逐帧打点，画出 s-t、v-t 图，比较匀速和斜面匀加速。
description.en: Mark a 3D cart frame by frame, grow s–t and v–t graphs, and compare uniform motion with motion down a ramp.

description.zh: 在可环视的 3D 光具座上调节物距、焦距和屏距，观察凸透镜形成实像、虚像与清晰投影的变化。
description.en: Adjust object distance, focal length, and screen position on an orbitable 3D optical bench to explore real images, virtual images, and sharp projection.

description.en: The shop only prices rectangles. Cut, slide, and reassemble parallelograms, triangles, and trapezoids until each area formula snaps into place.

description.en: Dial a cannon’s speed and angle, watch a red projectile and a yellow free-fall ball share a clock, then thread a hoop.

description.zh: 在迷你城市里用简单随机、分层、整群和便利抽样估通勤时间，看哪种方法会稳定地估错。
description.en: Sample a mini-city with simple random, stratified, cluster, and convenience draws to estimate commute time — and watch which method stays stably wrong.

description.zh: 把洗衣篮里的东西分进合适的筐，还能换个标准再分一次。
description.en: Sort the laundry into the right baskets, then try a different rule.

description.zh: 在 3D 实验台上换一杯新样品、拧 pH、滴指示剂，看烧杯里的示意颜色怎么变；每次都是新样品，不会混合。
description.en: On a 3D bench, swap in a fresh sample, twist the pH, and drip an indicator to watch the beaker colour. Each choice is a new cup — nothing is mixed.

description.zh: 把王国信件拆成编号数据包，规划最短驿道，并在桥梁坍塌后为未送达的骑士实时改道。
description.en: Split a royal message into numbered packets, plan the shortest relay route, and reroute undelivered knights when a bridge collapses.

description.zh: 用「前进、右转、重复」指挥小海龟画出正方形、五角星和彩虹螺旋 —— 你的第一门编程语言！
description.en: Command a turtle with “forward, right, repeat” to draw squares, stars and rainbow spirals — your first programming language!

description.zh: 机器人管家完全按字面执行命令：顺序排错不报错，而是忠实演出一场厨房灾难——先涂黄油再进烤箱？糊啦！排对指令卡，让挑剔的小主人吃上完整早餐。
description.en: The robot butler does exactly what you say: wrong order means no error message — just a faithful kitchen disaster. Butter before toasting? Charcoal! Arrange the cards so breakfast survives.

description.zh: 组建动物乐队，乐谱只能用循环块写：重复 4 次[咚 哒]！把循环套进循环做出整首歌，用越少的块写出同样的音乐，乐队评分越高。
description.en: Form an animal band whose sheet music is made of loop blocks: repeat 4 × [boom clap]! Nest loops to build whole songs — fewer blocks for the same music means a higher score.

description.zh: 给动物园的自动喂食机编规则：如果是食草动物就投青草，否则投肉——直到熊猫出现！加特例、调顺序、组合与和或，看你的规则机一只不错地喂饱 30 只动物。
description.en: Program the zoo's auto-feeder: IF herbivore THEN grass ELSE meat — until the panda shows up! Add special cases, reorder rules, combine AND/OR, and feed 30 animals without a single mix-up.

description.zh: 给生病的小程序做听诊：先预测病灶，再逐行执行、观察变量，只改一行让计数器、机器人和循环恢复健康。
description.en: Diagnose sick programs: predict the faulty line, step through the code, watch variables change, then fix one line to heal counters, robots, and loops.

description.zh: 企鹅按个头排队只能两两比较、相邻交换。先徒手排，再雇冒泡、选择、插入三位算法教练同场赛跑——比较次数实时对决，亲眼看出算法的性格！
description.en: Penguins line up by height, but you can only compare two at a time. Sort by hand, then hire Bubble, Selection and Insertion coaches for a three-lane algorithm race — comparison counters dueling live!

description.zh: 把金币、龙的怒气和颜色装进会变化的魔法罐，用赋值咒语让数值增长、翻倍，再借一个空罐完成经典交换谜题。
description.en: Store coins, dragon anger, and colors in changing magic jars. Use assignment spells to update and double values, then borrow an empty jar to solve the classic swap puzzle.

description.zh: 在爆单甜品店里把重复步骤封装成配方函数，再传入口味和大小参数，用短短几行调用完成整队订单。
description.en: Survive a dessert-shop rush by packaging repeated steps into a recipe function, then pass flavor and size parameters to serve a whole queue with short calls.

description.zh: 给可爱鬼屋接上“当…就…”事件导线，让游客开门、踩地板和碰机关时触发惊喜，最后搭出一整条连锁反应。
description.en: Wire a friendly haunted house with when-then event connections. Trigger surprises as visitors open doors and step on tiles, then build one big chain reaction.

description.zh: 值守五盏只有亮与灭的海岛信号灯，用 16、8、4、2、1 的位值发送数字、解读来船灯语，再把 SOS 编成秘密信号。
description.en: Run five island signal lamps with only on and off states. Use place values 16, 8, 4, 2, and 1 to send numbers, decode ships, and encode SOS.

description.zh: 拨动会发光的琴弦，在示波器里看见频率与振幅，再把闹钟送进真空罩，完成一场看得见的声音演出。
description.en: Pluck a glowing string, watch frequency and amplitude on an oscilloscope, then send an alarm clock into a vacuum chamber for a sound show you can see.

topic.zh: 声音的产生、传播与变化

description.zh: 在只能发送数字的像素邮局里复制 8×8 邮票、把 0 和 1 还原成图，再用行程长度编码压缩电报。
description.en: Copy an 8×8 stamp at a post office that can only send digits, rebuild art from 0s and 1s, then compress telegrams with run-length encoding.

description.zh: 接管青蛙音乐节的灯光台，用红绿蓝色光合成白光、用青黄颜料调出绿色，再让三棱镜展开白光里的彩虹。
description.en: Run the Frog Festival light desk: combine red, green, and blue light into white, mix cyan and yellow pigment into green, then unfold the rainbow hidden in white light.

description.zh: 在会呼吸的玩具港口里装货、捏橡皮泥船、预测材料沉浮。看吃水线一点点下降，亲手把会沉的泥球变成能载三颗螺丝帽的小船。
description.en: Load cargo, reshape clay, and predict what floats in a lively toy harbor. Watch the waterline rise, then turn a sinking clay ball into a little boat that carries three metal nuts.

topic.zh: 认识船、设计和制作小船

description.zh: 化身五感小侦探：听声音、摸触感、闻气味、照剪影，让不符合证据的候选一个个退场，用最少线索猜中盒中宝物。
description.en: Become a senses detective: listen, touch, smell, and reveal a silhouette. Eliminate suspects with evidence and identify the hidden object using as few clues as possible.

description.zh: 给扫地机器人装上随机转向、弓字清扫或沿墙行走策略芯片，在三种户型里实测覆盖率、用时和碰撞，找出每间房的算法冠军。
description.en: Fit a robo-vacuum with random-turn, lawnmower, or wall-following strategy chips, then benchmark coverage, time, and bumps across three very different rooms.

description.zh: 经营一家会见证变形的旅馆：为蝴蝶、青蛙和蝗虫的每个生命阶段安排合适房间，看它们从入住到退房彻底变样。
description.en: Run a hotel that witnesses amazing transformations. Match every life stage of a butterfly, frog, and grasshopper with the right room, then watch each guest check out transformed.

description.zh: 用 JPL 轨道要素探索 3D 太阳系，切换参考系与多种视角，看太阳如何带着八大行星在银河中画出斜螺旋。
description.en: Explore a 3D solar system built from JPL orbital elements, switch frames and viewpoints, and see the Sun carry all eight planets along a slanted helix.

description.zh: 接管天空运营公司：调大太阳让湖水蒸发、送水汽上高空凝成云、攒够重量按下降水！雨、雪、雾、雹全是同一套水循环机器的不同参数。
description.en: Run the sky company: crank up the sun to evaporate the lake, lift vapor to condense into clouds, then press the rain button! Rain, snow, fog and hail are just different settings of one water-cycle machine.

description.zh: 物质是一间迪斯科舞厅，分子是舞客，你是掌管温度的 DJ：慢歌固态方阵摇摆，快歌液态滑动，拉满全场乱飞变气态！微观舞池与宏观视图左右分屏、永远同步。
description.en: Matter is a disco, molecules are dancers, and you're the DJ of temperature: slow songs for a solid lattice, faster for liquid flow, max it out and dancers fly off as gas! Micro dance floor and macro view stay in sync, side by side.

description.zh: 在开放实验台自由放置电池、灯泡、电机、开关和保护器件，搭建串联、并联与混合电路；实时观察电压、电流、功率和亮度，制造并修复断路、短路，还能保存自己的夜光小镇。
description.en: Freely place batteries, lamps, motors, switches, junctions, and protection devices. Build series, parallel, or mixed circuits; observe live voltage, current, power, and brightness; create and repair faults; then save your glowing town.

description.zh: 入职地球运行调度中心：拨自转让北京日出，推公转让悉尼入夏，再亲手把 23.5° 的地轴掰直——全球四季瞬间消失！春夏秋冬全挂在这根斜斜的轴上。
description.en: Join Earth Operations: spin the globe to give Beijing a sunrise, push it along its orbit to bring summer to Sydney, then straighten the 23.5° axial tilt with your own hands — and watch the seasons vanish worldwide!

topic.zh: 白天与黑夜、四季的形成

description.zh: 友善的狼人请你当生活规划师：满月夜开嚎叫音乐会，新月夜隐身买薯片。亲手拖动月球公转，从地球视角看月亮圆缺——月相原来是位置魔术！
description.en: A friendly werewolf needs a life planner: howling concerts on full moons, invisible chip runs on new moons. Drag the Moon around its orbit and watch its phase from Earth — it's all a game of positions!

unitTitle.zh: 地球 太阳 月球

description.zh: 无罗盘的古代大海上，你是领航员：连星成图认出大熊座，从北斗勺口延伸五倍找到北极星——全天唯一不动的星。开启星轨快进，满天星辰绕它画出同心圆弧！
description.en: On an ancient compass-less sea, you are the navigator: connect stars into the Great Bear, extend the Dipper's edge five times to find Polaris — the one star that never moves. Fast-forward the night and watch every star arc around it!

description.zh: 把自己缩小，坐上皮划艇随一口饭菜漂流人体：口腔急流、食道蠕动滑道、胃酸漩涡、小肠绒毛森林、大肠脱水隧道……最后你懂的出口。课本上的名词成了一条河。
description.en: Shrink down and raft through the body with a bite of food: mouth rapids, esophagus peristalsis slides, stomach acid whirlpools, the villi forest of the small intestine, the dehydration tunnel… and that exit. Textbook words become a river.

description.zh: 一场不许碰球的冰球赛！球是磁铁，你手里也是磁铁：翻面用吸力拉、斥力推，隔空把球送进球门。戴上磁场眼镜，看不见的磁力线第一次现出原形。
description.en: Ice hockey where touching the puck is forbidden! The puck is a magnet and so is yours: flip N/S to pull or push it into the goal from a distance. Put on field goggles and see invisible field lines come alive.

description.zh: 在古埃及工地试用斜面、杠杆和滑轮组：让石块变轻的同时，亲眼看见绳子和路会变长。
description.en: Run an ancient Egyptian worksite with ramps, levers, and pulleys. Make a stone easier to move, then see the path or rope become longer.

description.zh: 用杯子潜水、气球天平和气球赛车，亲手发现空气占地方、有重量，还能把车子推出去。
description.en: Dive a cup, weigh balloons, and race a balloon car to see that air takes up space, has mass, and can push.

description.zh: 在回收工厂当分拣员：按材料把废品送进变形舱，看塑料瓶变外套、易拉罐变车架、废纸变新绘本。
description.en: Work the recycling line: sort scrap by material into transform pods and watch bottles become fleece, cans become bike frames, and paper become new books.

description.zh: 把整座彩虹塔搬到另一根柱子上，大盘子不能压小盘子。你能用最少的步数完成吗？
description.en: Move the rainbow tower to another peg — never place a big disc on a small one. Can you do it in the fewest moves?

description.zh: 用岛上材料搭净水流水线：沉淀、过滤、再蒸馏。清澈见底的水也可能是咸的。
description.en: Build a survival water line: settle, filter, then distill. Crystal-clear water can still be salty.

description.zh: 加入藏在课桌后的秘密社团，旋转凯撒密码盘加密纸条、倒转钥匙解密暗号，再用字母频率在没有钥匙时破译密文。
description.en: Join a secret school club: turn a Caesar wheel to encrypt notes, reverse the key to decrypt clues, then crack a message with letter frequency.

description.zh: 亲手转动一颗金属镜面 3D 魔方！2×2、3×3、4×4 三种阶数，镜面/经典/马卡龙/霓虹四套皮肤，三档打乱难度，卡住了还有提示和自动还原演示。
description.en: Spin a metal-mirror 3D Rubik's cube! Sizes 2×2–4×4, four skins (mirror/classic/macaron/neon), three scramble levels, plus hints and an auto-solve demo.

description.zh: 一层层往下挖：塑料玩具、陶罐、猛犸牙、恐龙骨。深度就是时光机，再把骨头拼活，对齐错位的断层。
description.en: Dig down through toys, pottery, a mammoth tusk, and dinosaur bone. Depth is a time machine — then rebuild the fossil and match a faulted pit.

description.zh: 在上帝视角的小岛上投放草、兔、狐、蘑菇和蚯蚓，看种群曲线实时起伏。移走一种动物，让整座岛在连锁反应里复苏或崩溃——食物链，一环都别断。
description.en: Stock a tiny island with grass, rabbits, foxes, mushrooms, and earthworms, then watch the population curves swing in real time. Remove one species and the whole island blooms or collapses — every link in the food web matters.

description.zh: 在逼真的 3D 木制华容道里传递两格空位，让曹操从南门离开；可自由闯关、分步提示，也能暂停回看完整解法演示。
description.en: Pass two empty cells around a realistic 3D wooden Huarong Dao and guide Cao Cao through the south gate, with free play, progressive hints, and a pausable full solution demo.

description.zh: 在会碎的冰桥上规划一笔滑行：先用奇偶眼镜看穿七桥为何无解，再滑完一条欧拉回路，最后亲手改桥救活冰雪小镇。
description.en: Plan one-stroke skating routes on fragile ice bridges: expose why the seven-bridge map is impossible, skate an Euler circuit, then repair the town by changing its graph.

description.zh: 打开土壤 X 光：看胚根往下钻、对照田比命运、点亮根茎叶花果图鉴。
description.en: Switch on soil X-ray: watch the radicle drill down, compare two plots, and light up root, stem, leaf, flower, and fruit.

topic.zh: 播种发芽、根和茎、开花结果

description.zh: 亲手转动一颗金属三阶金字塔魔方！四面蓝红黄绿，轻松/进阶/大师三档打乱，卡住了有「帮我一步」和还原演示，还有玩法小课堂。
description.en: Spin a metal 3-layer Pyraminx! Four faces in blue, red, yellow and green, three scramble levels, step hints, auto-solve demo, and a mini tutorial.

description.zh: 用“是球 / 不是球”的例子训练机器狗，亲眼发现样本太少造成的误判，再补充多样例和反例，让它在公园认出从没见过的新球。
description.en: Train a robo-dog with ball and not-ball examples, catch mistakes caused by narrow data, then add varied examples so it recognizes new balls at the park.

description.zh: 帮小动物们住进笼舍！每行、每列、每个园区都不能有重复的动物。从 4×4 新手村一路闯到 9×9 传奇峰，5 级难度等你挑战！
description.en: House the animals so no row, column or pen repeats! Climb five difficulty tiers, from a friendly 4×4 village to the legendary 9×9 peak.

description.zh: 毛毛虫只吃「有规律的东西」：红-黄-红-黄-？喂对下一个它就长一节，颜色、声音、动作三种规律轮番登场。吃饱结茧，破茧的蝴蝶翅膀就是它吃过的规律花纹！
description.en: This caterpillar only eats things that follow a pattern: red-yellow-red-yellow-? Feed the right next item and it grows. Colors, sounds and moves — then it spins a cocoon, and the butterfly's wings wear every pattern it ate!

description.zh: 给摇晃货架加斜撑，把三角形三个角拼成平角，再用木条亲手验证三边关系，完成三项三角形实验。
description.en: Brace a wobbly shelf, fit three corner pieces into a straight angle, and test stick lengths to discover the triangle inequality.

topic.zh: 三角形的特征与内角和

description.zh: 戴上夜视仪清点三脚兽和四脚兽，用尝试调整、假设法和眼腿传感器破解三份外星农场清单。
description.en: Use night vision to count three-legged and four-legged aliens, then solve farm manifests by trial, assumption, and eye-and-leg sensor clues.

description.zh: 谁偷吃了蛋糕？读线索、在网格上钉下 ❌ 和 ✅，看排除法像多米诺一样连锁倒下，红线在软木板上织出真相之网——经典逻辑网格谜题的侦探社版本。
description.en: Who ate the cake? Read clues, pin ❌ and ✅ on the grid, and watch elimination cascade like dominoes as red strings weave the truth across the corkboard — classic logic-grid puzzles, detective style.

description.zh: 在逼真的 3D 轨道海关扫描两条规则，把飞船停进左集、交集、右集或集合外；支持分步提示与可暂停的完整任务演示。
description.en: Scan two rules in a realistic 3D orbital customs deck, dock ships in the left set, intersection, right set, or outside region, and review a pausable full mission demo.

description.zh: 和狡猾的狐狸轮流拿石子，每次 1–3 颗，拿到最后一颗就赢。狐狸开始总赢——直到你在复盘板上盯出「4 的倍数」的秘密，从结局倒着算出必胜策略！
description.en: Take turns grabbing 1–3 stones from a sly fox — whoever takes the last stone wins. The fox keeps winning… until you spot the multiples-of-4 trap on the replay board and reason backwards to a winning strategy!

description.zh: 拖动、旋转和翻转七块七巧板，完成桥、狐狸、大雁、帆船、小屋、松树、飞鸟和星星八幕皮影戏。
description.en: Slide, turn and flip all seven tangram pieces to complete eight shadow-play scenes.

description.zh: 狼、羊、白菜都想过河，可有些乘客不能被单独留下。挑选船客、规划往返，让每一座河岸始终安全；走错时，小剧场会替你把时间倒回来。
description.en: A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage all need to cross, but some passengers cannot be left alone together. Plan every outward and return trip, keep both banks safe, and let the story rewind when a crossing goes wrong.

description.zh: 一箱金币里混着一枚轻一点的假币。用天平称，每称一次付一枚佣金。发现天平会说三种话，一次就能把嫌疑砍成三分之一！
description.en: A lighter fake hides among the gold. Each weighing costs a coin. Discover the scale's three answers and cut the suspects into thirds every time!

description.zh: 给真假村民贴身份徽章，拆开“与、或、非”的线索，最后问出让两位守卫都指向错误道路的神问题。
description.en: Badge truth-tellers and liars, unpack AND, OR, and NOT clues, then ask the legendary question that makes either guard point to the wrong road.

description.zh: 把纸折成小方块、打下一孔，再在展开图上预测所有孔位。沿折痕拖开纸张，看一个孔怎样连续镜像成二、四、八，最后绽放成十六孔纸花。
description.en: Fold a sheet into a tiny square, punch once, and predict every hole on the open paper. Drag the folds apart to watch one hole mirror into two, four, eight, and finally a sixteen-hole paper bloom.

description.zh: 先在脑中预测光路，再摆放和旋转斜镜。让激光绕过障碍、穿过分光镜和彩色滤镜，依次点亮整座镜屋的水晶。
description.en: Predict each route before placing and rotating diagonal mirrors. Guide laser beams around walls, through a splitter and color filters, then light every crystal in the mirror house.

description.zh: 给王国地图上色：相邻领地不能同色，颜料按桶收钱。从挥霍五色到紧预算、领主点名，直到亲手发现——四色永远够用。
description.en: Color the kingdom map so neighbors never share a hue, while paint costs by the bucket. Spend freely, tighten the budget, obey a lord's demand, then feel why four colors always suffice.

description.zh: 切开制冰机看制冷回路：灌水、开压缩机、看蒸发器吸热结冰，再发现冷凝器把热甩到房间——热被搬走了，不是消失了。
description.en: Cut open an ice maker: fill molds, run the compressor, watch the evaporator steal heat to freeze water, then catch the condenser dumping that heat into the room.

description.zh: 派对魔法师专赌「必然」：先拼命给客人排不同生日月份想赢他，再接过魔法棒，用抽屉原理开出稳赢的袜子与同名赌局。
description.en: A party wizard only bets on sure things. First try to beat him by seating guests with different birth months—then take the wand and open sure-win sock and name bets with the pigeonhole principle.

description.zh: 少文字、强动画：点零件认识电脑，看数据在 CPU 与内存之间飞来飞去，最后自己当 CPU 算出 7+5。
description.en: Less text, more motion: tap parts, watch data fly between CPU and memory, then be the CPU to make 7+5.

description.zh: 在三维球棍台上拼出甲烷、乙烯、乙醇和乙酸，用量角器读键角，再用四瓶试剂填满反应矩阵，最后找出同分异构体。
description.en: Build methane, ethene, ethanol and acetic acid on a 3D ball-and-stick bench, read bond angles with a protractor, fill a four-reagent reaction matrix, then hunt down the isomers.

description.zh: 在三维地球旁调高度和水平速度，做出坠回、椭圆、圆轨和逃逸四种结局，读周期、画速度带，最后自己算出同步轨道。
description.en: Dial altitude and horizontal speed beside a 3D Earth to produce re-entry, ellipse, circle and escape, read the periods, map the speed bands, then work out the synchronous orbit yourself.

description.zh: 在三维双螺旋上解旋、按 A-T 与 G-C 配对补出新链，看半保留复制留下的老链，再换掉一个碱基追踪密码子和氨基酸的变化。
description.en: Unwind a 3D double helix, pair new bases by A-T and G-C, see which parental strands survive semi-conservative replication, then swap one base and track the codon and amino acid.

description.zh: 给沙漠、暴风雪和湿地各拼一只活得下去的动物：同一零件换个地方，就可能从神器变成累赘。
description.en: Build a creature that can live in desert, blizzard, and wetland. The same part can be a gift in one place and trouble in another.

description.zh: 在 3D 实验桌上拧电压和电阻，看着电流光点穿过电阻，记下 U-I 读数，让图线自己说出欧姆定律。
description.en: Twist voltage and resistance on a 3D bench, watch the spark along the resistor, save U-I readings, and let the plot reveal Ohm’s law.

bookTitle.zh: 物理 九年级全一册

topic.zh: 电流与电压、电阻的关系

description.zh: 在 3D 实验台上倒醋、看气泡：敞口装置变轻，盖上密闭罩后，质量又完整回到天平上。
description.en: Pour vinegar on a 3D bench and watch the bubbles: an open vessel gets lighter, then a sealed dome brings every gram back to the balance.

description.zh: 拧物镜、调光、粗细准焦，看模糊光斑突然变成细胞，再量视野直径，比较洋葱表皮和口腔上皮。
description.en: Pick an objective, light and focus until a blur snaps into cells, then measure the field of view and compare onion skin with cheek cells.

bookTitle.zh: 生物学 七年级上册

description.zh: 在图画花园里给常见汉字找到对应的事物。
description.en: Find the picture that belongs to each familiar character.

topic.zh: 天地人、口耳目手足、日月山川

description.en: Match lines to pictures, finish couplets and order whole poems.

description.en: Load the stroke cards onto the train in writing order.

description.zh: 给玩具换件彩色衣裳，听听颜色的英文。
description.en: Paint your toys and hear the names of their colors.

description.zh: 摘三件水果去野餐，点一下听听英文名字。
description.en: Pick three fruits for a picnic and tap to hear their names.

description.zh: 布置你的小乐园，和会动的动物朋友认识一下。
description.en: Build a little park and meet your moving animal friends.

description.zh: 给小火车装积木，听着英文一起数到十。
description.en: Load blocks onto a little train and count to ten in English.

description.zh: 点一点身体部位，让小伙伴和你一起动起来。
description.en: Tap a body part and make your little friend move.

description.zh: 整理自己的小书包，把学习用品的英文带回家。
description.en: Pack your school bag and learn the names of your school things.
